name: Shepherds' Field, Bethlehem
scene: the terraced hills of the Shepherds' Field outside Bethlehem at dusk, a stone sheepfold and a small cave, a few sheep, olive trees, the lights of Bethlehem on the ridge, one bright star low in a deep blue sky, a single distant shepherd seen from behind

name: Jordan River at Qasr al-Yahud

name: Summit of Mount Sinai at dawn
scene: the granite summit of Mount Sinai at dawn, a small stone chapel, jagged red mountains rolling away in layers of pink and violet mist, the sun just breaking the horizon, a few pilgrims far away wrapped in blankets seen from behind

name: Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives
scene: the view of Jerusalem's Old City walls and golden domes from the Mount of Olives in late afternoon, ancient olive trees of Gethsemane and old stone graves on the slope in the foreground, the Kidron Valley between, warm golden light

name: The Garden Tomb, Jerusalem
scene: a quiet garden in Jerusalem at sunrise with an ancient rock-cut tomb, a large round stone rolled aside from the entrance, flowering plants and cypress trees, soft beams of morning light falling into the empty doorway

name: Mount of Beatitudes
